decisions.label: Crown whole over the Terrace
decisions.note: On, the great oak's crown is whole over the Terrace as over every room: no gap over it, no notch out to the crown's edge and no ring of lights round them (Ed, 2026-10-26: "I'd like to try the treehouse canopy not being cut-through while she's in treehouse mode - this will make it easier for her to land in the treehouse successfully, as the area is bigger"). Indoors it's cleared over the room she's in and round her, the Terrace too, as ever. Off: the gap and its notch as before (#1172). The crown's grown again as it's flipped.

decisions.label: Terrace drawn as one of the rooms
decisions.note: On, the Terrace is one of the house's rooms under the crown, not drawn on its own (Ed, 2026-10-26: "I also want to try not having the terrace drawn separately"): from outside its art (its round of wood, her decks, the DJ table, the tempo over them) isn't drawn, only the crown over it, and it shows when she's in the house as every room does (a knockout's candles still show). In the house it's as before, the forest showing behind it. Off: the Terrace drawn on its own from outside, as before (#1172).

decisions.label: Forest fades in behind the house (s)
decisions.note: In the house the forest stays dark behind every room, the Terrace too, till the island has loaded (its art drawn); then it fades in behind the whole treehouse over this many seconds of her clock, and stays (Ed, 2026-10-26: "When the forest has loaded, fade it in gradually behind the whole treehouse"). It was dark behind the enclosed rooms always. 0.5 nearly at once; 4 a slow reveal.
